parsed.rationale: HSBColor.uiColor (line 53) and HSBColor.nsColor (line 63) are computed properties in Shared/ColorPalette/Sources/ColorPalette/HSBColor.swift that target fundamentally different platform types: UIColor (UIKit/iOS) and NSColor (AppKit/macOS). Although their Jaccard similarity is 0.71, the divergence is intentional and load-bearing — each property must return a distinct, platform-specific color type that cannot be unified into a single generic return type without losing type safety or requiring conditional compilation that would be no cleaner than the current two-property design. Collapsing them into a generic function would require an unconstrained or protocol-bounded type parameter that no standard Swift protocol currently satisfies across UIColor and NSColor, making the refactor speculative rather than grounded.
